authorization_boundary: This manifest creates no invitation or permission to recruit. A live pilot needs an agreed scope, consent, credit choice and named owner before contact.

cue_audit.finding: The frozen pack stores items in construction-family order. Showing its raw array order or P-identifiers could reveal a pattern.
cue_audit.control: Administer only the extracted source, claim and blank response record in the slot order below. Use presentation_id, not item_id, on the reviewer-facing form. Do not show repository links, pack metadata, condition labels, hashes, the manifest or another response until submission.
cue_audit.residual_risk: All material is public. Record prior exposure and any browsing of Candidates A-F or the answer-key discussion as a protocol deviation; do not claim blinding when exposure is known or unknown.

response_freeze: Record each individual response and reason before discussion, reconciliation or access to expected annotations.

primary_readout.subset: Items pre-registered as overreach_valid_reference in the hidden expected-annotation file.
primary_readout.event: All material clauses marked supported and human_decision marked keep.
primary_readout.report: accepted events / submitted responses in the subset, separately for baseline and criteria. Report missing responses separately.

secondary_outputs: errors introduced after seeing Candidates A-F
